scope: Additive current-source follow-up for Revenge Tower; records corroborated stage observations while preserving the missing deterministic lifecycle.
game_version: Official January 2026 balance information and public secondary pages consulted on 2026-09-20.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
sources.limitations: Confirms current stage-2/3 thresholds 25/50 and final-stage 350-ms cadence, but not destroyed-building accounting, health growth, transitions, target selection, projectile travel, branching geometry or tick ordering.

sources.title: Revenge Tower
sources.limitations: Corroborates inactive-but-targetable status, air/ground target type, 11-tile primary range, two-tile approximate branch reach and 60% branch decay. It has no immutable client build or reproducible selection, boundary, collision or lifecycle trace.

sources.title: Revenge Tower
sources.limitations: Corroborates L1/L2 5,800/6,200 HP and 50/60 displayed DPS from a stated client build, but explicitly does not verify the special behavior and publishes no stage lifecycle or target/collision contract.

sources.title: Revenge Tower
sources.limitations: Corroborates the current 5/25/50 thresholds, 1.2/0.6/0.35-second stages and published per-branch damage table, but does not identify a build or specify destruction accounting, transition timing, branch selection, geometry, collision or same-tick order.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines whether and when a destruction on the same logical tick updates the stage relative to a shot, a target loss or Tower destruction.
No exact stage health increase, stage-transition duration/cooldown, target retention or re-acquisition rule is published.
No reproducible branch candidate selection, two-tile boundary, line/collision rule, projectile flight model or tertiary-hop ordering is published.
conclusion: The 20 September follow-up corroborates the current 5/25/50 thresholds, 350-ms final cadence, inactive-but-targetable status and reported branch values, but does not close the future-affecting destruction-stage or chain lifecycle. Revenge Tower remains data-only; no generic direct or bounce defense is enabled.
